selected_experts.reason: Primary verification of class identity. Must distinguish between daisy, chamomile, and other asteraceae.
To check for edge bleeding between white petals and green background, and ensure petals are discrete entities.
Holistic assessment of texture realism (granular center vs. smooth) and lighting consistency.
Verify that the 3D structure of the disc florets and petal layering is physically plausible.

focus_areas: Texture granularity of the yellow center (must not be smooth/plastic)
Edge definition of white petals against green background (check for haloing/bleeding)
Petal symmetry and natural variation (avoid perfect radial symmetry)
Lighting consistency on petals (shadows under overlapping petals)
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the yellow center. AI often fails to render the complex granular texture of disc florets, resulting in a smooth yellow disk. Verify if the texture is genuinely granular. Also, inspect the petal edges for 'haloing' or unnatural blending with the bokeh background. Check for repetitive petal shapes which indicate generative repetition.
